literal: Strangers to eat fully, relatives will starve, a fool great wealth when attained.
translation: When a fool attains great wealth, strangers will eat their fill while his own relatives starve.
modern: ஒரு அறிவிலி பெருஞ்செல்வத்தை அடைந்தால், அவனுக்குத் தொடர்பில்லாத அயலார் வயிறார உண்பார்கள்; ஆனால் அவனுடைய உறவினர்கள் பசியால் வாடுவார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet illustrates the misplaced priorities of a foolish person who acquires wealth. Instead of supporting their own family and relatives, a fool squanders their resources on strangers who might simply flatter them. The sharp contrast between strangers eating fully and relatives starving highlights the fool's complete lack of judgment and moral responsibility.
